observation.command:
CTX=/tmp/addon_exec; rm -rf $CTX; mkdir -p $CTX
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/. $CTX/
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/data-structures $CTX/data-structures
cat > $CTX/executors/Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm AS builder

WORKDIR /wheels

COPY ./executors/pyproject.toml .
COPY ./executors/demospipes_addon_bmds_executors/ ./demospipes_addon_bmds_executors/
COPY ./data-structures/ ./shared-data-structures/
COPY ./data_structures/ ./addon-data-structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ ./shared-data-structures/ && \
    pip wheel --no-deps --no-cache-dir -w /tmp/local-wheels/ ./addon-data-structures/

RUN pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --find-links /tmp/local-wheels/ \
    --wheel-dir /wheels .

FROM demospipes-base-executors:v1.24.195-main-8a31fa9 AS final

USER root

WORKDIR /wheels
COPY --from=builder /wheels .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --no-index --find-links=. ./*.whl && \
    rm -rf /wheels

ENV HOME=/home/user
ENV PREFECT_HOME=$HOME/.prefect

RUN useradd user -u 1001 -g 0 && \
    mkdir -p "$PREFECT_HOME" && chown -R user "$PREFECT_HOME"

USER user

WORKDIR /app

COPY ./executors/schemas/ ./schemas/
COPY ./executors/scripts/start-workers.sh ./
COPY ./executors/scripts/autorestart-worker.sh ./

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["sh", "start-workers.sh"]
EOF
cd $CTX && DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 nohup docker build -t demospipes-addon-bmds-executors:latest -f executors/Dockerfile . > /tmp/build_addon_exec.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 90; tail -18 /tmp/build_addon_exec.log
